description: ANCIENTKIT demo built only from the ruin, relic, wild and land kits: an oasis at the edge of a buried city, the processional sun road to a pylon gate, the roofless sanctum and an overgrown court with a great sun dial. Original names, figures, glyphs and designs.

endings.text: The dial's shadow shrinks to nothing. Somewhere under the sand a door that waited a thousand years for noon opens.

flags.description: Weight on the sanctum plate; the east door is unsealed
The gold sun key from the reliquary
The great dial turned to noon

landmarks.name: The pylon gate under the pyramid
The fig that ate a column

interactions.label: Read the waystone
interactions.text: Glyphs climb the stone in rows: a sun, a road, a door that wants weight, and a dial with its shadow gone.

interactions.label: Talk to Tamsin
interactions.text: Tamsin fills your flask. "The sun road starts at the east gate. The sanctum door listens for weight, not for keys. Drink before you go."

interactions.label: Talk to Orrin
interactions.text: Orrin lowers his sighting rod. "Every carving on that pylon shows the sun turning. Somebody stopped it. Somebody could start it again."

interactions.label: Step onto the sun plate
interactions.text: The plate sinks under you with a sigh of sand. In the east wall, stone grinds on stone.

interactions.label: Open the reliquary
interactions.text: Under the lid lies a small gold sun on a stone pin, warm as if it had been in someone's hand.

interactions.label: Set the gold sun on the dial
interactions.text: You set the gold sun on the gnomon and push. The great dial turns, and its shadow walks toward noon.

interactions.label: Talk to Ilka
interactions.text: Ilka pats the fig's roots. "It ate the column, but it kept the dial clear. Trees know what matters."

rooms.description: A spring under leaning palms at the edge of a buried city. The colossal head of a stone Keeper watches the water from the sand, its fan crown half drowned in the dunes.
rooms.name: Oasis of the Patient Sun

rooms.description: A paved processional way runs north between crested guardians to a pylon gate. Beyond the wall the stepped pyramid of the Patient Sun climbs into the haze.
rooms.name: The Sun Road

rooms.description: The vault fell long ago and the sky looks in. Processions of bearers walk the carved walls toward a gold sun on its altar; braziers still burn on either side.
rooms.name: Sanctum of the Patient Sun

rooms.description: Behind the sanctum the city gives way to green. A stepped court holds a great sun dial, and a fig has swallowed a column whole.
rooms.name: The Overgrown Court

tide.wait_text: The wind moves the sand a finger's width.

title: The Patient Sun
